title: unified-rollouts-enhanced-quarantine-probing-stage-autorollback-workflow
author: Aisha Malik
description: Motivation: improve safety and observability of automated rollback for staged shadow/canary rollouts by adding a quarantine/probing stage that isolates suspect traffic and increases metric quorum before triggering global rollback. This fixes flakiness observed during noisy upstream dependencies and reduces false positive rollbacks (see SUP-7890). Summary of changes: 1) rollout controller: new 'quarantine_probing' intermediate state with configurable duration, sample_ratio and min_quorum; 2) policy engine: metric quorum evaluation and sliding-window anomaly scoring; 3) observability: new metrics (rollout.quarantine.entered, rollout.quarantine.probe_failures, rollout.quarantine.quorum_met) and dashboards; 4) e2e and unit tests: simulated upstream noise scenarios and integration tests for quorum behavior; 5) SDK: rollout API extensions for canary configs. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-3456) - [x] Unit tests added for controller and policy modules - [x] Integration tests for staged shadow + quarantine - [x] Added dashboards/playbooks for oncall - [x] Backwards-compatible: default behavior unchanged when feature flag disabled Implementation notes: controller transition is guarded by feature flag rollout.quarantine_enabled and by a safety gate which requires both min_quorum and probe window to be set; transitions are idempotent and persisted in rollout status to survive controller restarts. Metric quorum uses per-metric voting across configured probe slices; quorum threshold is configurable per-rollout. Observability: emit detailed probe tags for sampling analysis. Migration: rollout specs with older shape continue to operate; new fields are optional. Testing: ran perf canary against medium traffic load (10k rps) and saw no measurable latency tail increase; e2e tests validate rollback only triggers after quorum fails across 3 consecutive probe windows. Release notes: Adds a quarantine/probing stage to unified rollouts to reduce false-positive auto-rollbacks; feature gated and off by default. Breaking change: none. Related PRs: pr-250123-unified-rollouts-observability-safety-guards.json, pr-61234-unified-rollouts-autorollback-enhancements.json
